name: Wave’s Sight
body:
Your faith in the Wind and the Waves helps you navigate through all manner of mist or haze.

Benefit(s): You can see normally up to 5 feet away in areas of non-magical fog, mist, rain, or similar conditions (such as the spray of a waterfall). Your sight is still obscured beyond 5 feet as normal in these conditions.
